ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) In the first 10 overs of a cricket game, the run rate was only 3.2. What should be the rate in the remaining 40 overs to each the target of 282 runs?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: In the first 10 overs of a cricket game, the run rate was only 3.2. What should be the rate in the remaining 40 overs to each the target of 282 runs?

Solution:
First 10 overs total run was = (3.2 × 10) = 32

Required run rate = (282 - 32)/40
= 250/40
= 6.25

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) The difference between a number and its two-fifth is 510. What is the ten percent of that number?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The difference between a number and its two-fifth is 510. What is the ten percent of that number?

Solution:
Let,
the number will be x.

ATQ,
x - (2x/5) = 510
⇒ (5x - 2x)/5 = 510
⇒ 3x/5 = 510
⇒ 3x = 510 × 5
⇒ x = 2550/3
x = 850

∴ The number of 10% = 850 × (10/100) = 85

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) A man deposits Tk. 5000 in a Bank at 10% interest rate compounded annually. At the end of the three year, the total amount including interest will become?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A man deposits Tk. 5000 in a Bank at 10% interest rate compounded annually. At the end of the three year, the total amount including interest will become?

Solution: 
Given,
Principal, P = 5000 Tk.
Rate of interest, r = 10% = 10/100 = 1/10
Time, n = 3 years.

We know,
Compound Amount = P (1 + r)n
= 5000 × (1 + 1/10)3
= 5000 × (11/10)3
= 5000 × (11/10) × (11/10) × (11/10)
= 6655

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) If x and y are negative, then which of the following statements is always true?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: If x and y are negative, then which of the following statements is always true?

Solution:
If x < 0 and y < 0 then xy > 0.
So, whenever x and y are negative, then xy is positive.

Example: If x = - 1 and y = - 1 then xy = (- 1) × (- 1) = 1 > 0

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) If (2p + 1/p) = 4, the value of (p<sup>3</sup> + 1/8p<sup>3</sup>) is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: If (2p + 1/p) = 4, the value of (p3 + 1/8p3) is -

Solution:
Given,
(2p + 1/p) = 4
Or, (1/2) (2p + 1/p) = 4 × 1/2
Or, p + 1/2p = 2

Now, (p3 + 1/8p3) = (p)3 + (1/2p)3
= (p + 1/2p)3 - 3 . p . 1/2p . (p + 1/2p)
= (2)3 - 3 . (1/2) . 2
= 8 - 3
= 5

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) Three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6 and their products is 1944. The smallest number is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: Three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6 and their products is 1944. The smallest number is - 

Solution:
Let the number be 3x, 4x, 6x.

ATQ,
3x × 4x × 6x = 1944
⇒ 72x3 = 1944
⇒ x3 = 1944/72
⇒ x3 = 27
∴ x = 3

So the smallest number = 3x = 3 × 3 = 9

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: Two unbiased coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting at most one head?

Solution:
Total cases = {HH, HT, TH, TT} = 4
Favorable cases = {TT, HT, TH} = 3

∴ Required Probability = 3/4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) The angle of elevation of the sun, when the length of the shadow of a tree √3 times the height of the tree is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The angle of elevation of the sun, when the length of the shadow of a tree √3 times the height of the tree is:

Solution:

Let,
AB = height of tree
BC= Shadow of tree
angle of elevation = C
∴  BC = √3 AB

We know,
tanC = AB/BC
⇒ tanC = AB/√3AB
⇒ tanC = 1/√3
⇒ tanC = tan30°
∴ C = 30°

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) The sum of the present ages of the father and daughter is 90 years. If five years ago the age of father was four times that of his daughter, find the present age of the daughter.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The sum of the present ages of the father and daughter is 90 years. If five years ago the age of father was four times that of his daughter, find the present age of the daughter.

Solution: 
Let the age of daughter 5 years ago = x
The age of father 5 years ago = 4x

ATQ,
x + 5 + 4x + 5 = 90
⇒ 5x + 10 = 90
⇒ 5x = 80
∴ x = 16

∴ Daughter present age = 16 + 5 = 21 years.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A piece of wire 91 cm long is bent in the form of an isosceles triangle. If the ratio of one of the equal sides to the base is 5 : 3, then what is the length of the base?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A piece of wire 91 cm long is bent in the form of an isosceles triangle. If the ratio of one of the equal sides to the base is 5 : 3, then what is the length of the base?

Solution:
Given,
Ratio of one of the equal sides to the base is 5 : 3
Therefore, the sides are 5x, 3x, 5x.

91 cm piece of wire is bent to form an isosceles triangle.
Thus perimeter of triangle is 91 cm.

ATQ,
∴ 13x = 91
⇒ x = 7

Thus the length of the base = 3 × 7 = 21 cm.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) A company pays rent of Tk. 20000 per month for office space to its owner. But if the company pays the annual rent at the beginning of the year the owner gives a discount of 5% on the total annual rent. What is the annual amount the company pays to the owner after the discount?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A company pays rent of Tk. 20000 per month for office space to its owner. But if the company pays the annual rent at the beginning of the year the owner gives a discount of 5% on the total annual rent. What is the annual amount the company pays to the owner after the discount?

Solution:
Total annual rent = Tk. (20000 × 12) = Tk. 240000
Discount = 5% of tk. 240000
= Tk. 12000
∴ Annual rent paid after discount = Tk. (240000 - 12000)
= Tk. 228000

Question: Solve |2x - 3| ≤ 1

Solution:
|2x - 3| ≤ 1
⇒ - 1 ≤ 2x - 3 ≤ 1
⇒ - 1 + 3 ≤ 2x - 3 + 3 ≤ 1 + 3
⇒ 2 ≤ 2x ≤ 4
⇒ 2/2 ≤ 2x/2 ≤ 4/2
∴ 1 ≤ x ≤ 2

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) A train passes two bridges of length 800 m and 400 m in 100 seconds and 60 seconds respectively. The length of the train is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A train passes two bridges of length 800 m and 400 m in 100 seconds and 60 seconds respectively. The length of the train is -

Solution:
Let length of the train be x m and speed of the train is s kmph.
Speed, s = (x + 800)/100 . . . . . (i)
Speed, s = (x + 400)/60. . . . . (ii) 

Equating equation (i) and (ii),
we get,
(x + 800)/100 = (x + 400)/60
Or, (x + 800)/5 = (x + 400)/3
Or, 5x + 2000 = 3x + 2400
Or, 2x = 400
∴ x = 200m

∴ The length of the train is 200 meters.

Question: A man travels 50 km at speed 25 km/hr and next 40 km at 20 km/hr and there after travel 90 km at 15 km/hr. His average speed is:

Solution:

Average speed = Total distance/Total time
= (50 + 40 + 90)/(2 + 2 + 6) km/hr

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) If sin A = 1/2 , then the value of cotA is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: If sin A = 1/2 , then the value of cotA is -

Solution:
Given,
sinA = 1/2

We know,
cos2A = 1 - sin2A
= 1 - (1/2)2
= 1 - (1/4)
= (4 - 1)/4
= 3/4
∴ cosA = √(3/4)
= √3/2

Now,
cotA = cosA/sinA
= (√3/2)/(1/2)
= (√3/2) × 2
= √3

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) A and B together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, B left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, B alone could do the work in-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A and B together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, B left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, B alone could do the work in-

Solution:
(A + B)'s one day's work = 1/3 part
(A + B) works 2 days together = 2/3 part.

∴ Remaining work = 1 - (2/3) = 1/3 part

1/3 part of work is completed by A in two days.
Hence, one day's work of A = 1/6

Then, one day's work of B = (1/3) - (1/6)
= (2 - 1)/6
= 1/6

So, B alone can complete the whole work in 6 days.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) Let O be the in-center of a triangle ABC and D be a point on the side BC of ΔABC, such that OD ⊥ BC. If ∠BOD = 60°, then ∠ABC = ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: Let O be the in-center of a triangle ABC and D be a point on the side BC of ΔABC, such that OD ⊥ BC. If ∠BOD = 60°, then ∠ABC = ?

Solution:

Given,
∠BOD = 60°

We know,
∴ ∠BDO + ∠DOB + ∠DBO = 180°
⇒ ∠DBO = 180° - ∠BDO + ∠DOB
⇒ ∠DBO = 180° - 90° - 60°
∴ ∠DBO = 30°

Now,
∠ABC = 2 × ∠DBO
⇒ ∠ABC = 2 × 30°
∴ ∠ABC = 60°

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) The product of the roots of the equation 2a<sup>2</sup> - 5a + m = 10 is - 3. Find the value of m.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The product of the roots of the equation 2a2 - 5a + m = 10 is - 3. Find the value of m.

Solution:
Rearranging the given equation we have 2a2 - 5a + (m - 10) = 0

We know that,
if ax2 + bx + c = 0 is a quadratic equation, then the product of their roots = c/a

Given the product of the roots = - 3
⇒ (m - 10)/2 = - 3
⇒ (m - 10) = - 6
⇒ m = - 6 + 10
∴ m = 4

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) A father is three times as old as his son. After fifteen years father will be twice as old as his son age that time. What is the present age of the son?

Question: A father is three times as old as his son. After fifteen years father will be twice as old as his son age that time. What is the present age of the son?

Solution:
Let, the son's age be x years
and the father's age is = 3x years

ATQ,
3x + 15 = 2(x + 15)
⇒ 3x + 15 = 2x + 30
∴ x = 15

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) The universal set of U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} and A = {1, 3, 5}, B = {3, 5, 6} then determine (A′ ∩ B′).
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The universal set of U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} and A = {1, 3, 5}, B = {3, 5, 6} then determine (A′ ∩ B′).

Solution:
Given,
U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}
A = {1, 3, 5}
B = {3, 5, 6}

A‘ = U - A
= {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} - {1, 3, 5}
= {2, 4, 6}

B‘ = U - B
= {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} - {3, 5, 6}
= {1, 2, 4}

Now
(A‘ ∩ B‘) = {2, 4, 6} ∩ {1, 2, 4}
= {2, 4}

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) A sum of money is sufficient to pay A's wages for 21 days or B's wages for 28 days. The same money is sufficient to pay the wages of both for?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A sum of money is sufficient to pay A's wages for 21 days or B's wages for 28 days. The same money is sufficient to pay the wages of both for?

Solution:
Let
total money be Tk. x
A's 1 day's wages = Tk. x/21
B's 1 day's wages = Tk. x/28

∴ (A + B)'s 1 day's wages = Tk. (x/21 + x/28)
= Tk. (4x + 3x)/84
= Tk. 7x/84
= Tk. x/12

∴ Money is sufficient to pay the wages of both for 12 days.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) A Zoo keeper counted the heads of the animals in a zoo and found it to be 80. When he counted the legs of the animals he found it to be 260. If the zoo had either pigeons or horses, how many horses were there in the zoo?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A Zoo keeper counted the heads of the animals in a zoo and found it to be 80. When he counted the legs of the animals he found it to be 260. If the zoo had either pigeons or horses, how many horses were there in the zoo?

Solution: 
let, there are x horses and y pigeons.

ATQ,
x + y = 80 
⇒ x = 80 - y

and
4x + 2y = 260
⇒ 4 (80 - y) + 2y = 260 
⇒ 320 - 4y + 2y = 260 
⇒ 320 - 2y = 260
⇒ - 2y = 260 - 320
⇒ - 2y = - 60 
∴ y = 30 

∴ x = 80 - 30 
= 50
∴ There are 50 horses.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) If x/y = 5/3 then (3x - 2y)/(3x + 2y) =?

Question: If x/y = 5/3 then (3x - 2y)/(3x + 2y) =?

Solution:
x : y = 5/3
⇒ x/y = 5/3
⇒ 3x/2y = (5 × 3)/(3 × 2) [Multiplying by 3/2]
⇒ 3x/2y = 15/6
⇒ (3x - 2y)/(3x + 2y) = (15 - 6)/(15 + 6)
⇒ (3x - 2y)/(3x + 2y) = 9/21 
⇒ (3x - 2y)/(3x + 2y) = 3/7

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) Monir started a business investing Tk. 9000. After five months, Amir joined with a capital of Tk. 8000. If at the end of the year, they earn a profit of Tk. 6970, then what will be the share of Amir in the profit?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: Monir started a business investing Tk. 9000. After five months, Amir joined with a capital of Tk. 8000. If at the end of the year, they earn a profit of Tk. 6970, then what will be the share of Amir in the profit?

Solution:
Now as per the question,
Monir invested for 12 months
and Amir invested for (12 - 5) = 7 months.

So
Monir : Amir = (9000 × 12) : (8000 × 7)
= 108000 : 56000
= 108 : 56
= 27 : 14

Amir Ratio in profit will be = 6970 × (14/41)
= Tk. 2380

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) A man sells two books at Tk. 120 each and by doing so he gains 25% on one book and loses 25% on the other. His loss on the whole in Tk. is = ?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A man sells two books at Tk. 120 each and by doing so he gains 25% on one book and loses 25% on the other. His loss on the whole in Tk. is = ?

Solution:
Sells price of two books = (120 × 2) = Tk. 240
Cost price of first book = (100/125) × 120
= Tk. 96

Cost price of second book = (100/75) × 120
= Tk. 160

∴ Loss = (160 + 96) - 240
= 256 - 240
= Tk. 16

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩১) A can do a piece of work in 24 days. When he had worked for 4 days, B joined him. If the work was finished in 16 days, B can alone finish that work is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A can do a piece of work in 24 days. When he had worked for 4 days, B joined him. If the work was finished in 16 days, B can alone finish that work is -

Solution:
A's 1 day's work = 1/24 part
A's 16 day's work = 16/24 part
= 2/3 part

∴ Remaining work  = 1 - (2/3) = 1/3 part

1/3 part work done by B in (16 - 4) days = 12 days
∴ 1 part work done by B in (12 × 3) days = 36 days

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩২) If f(x) = x/(x - 2), x ≠ 2, then what is the value of f<sup> -1</sup>(3)?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: If f(x) = x/(x - 2), x ≠ 2, then what is the value of f -1(3)?

Solution:
let, f -1(3) = a
f(a) = 3

∴ f(a) = a/(a - 2) 

So,
a/(a - 2) = 3
⇒ a = 3a - 6
⇒ 3a - a = 6
⇒ 2a = 6
∴ a = 3

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩৩) The ratio of milk and water in a solution is 20 : 7 and after adding 5 liters of water in it the ratio of milk and water becomes 5 : 3, then find the final amount of water in the final solution.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: The ratio of milk and water in a solution is 20 : 7 and after adding 5 liters of water in it the ratio of milk and water becomes 5 : 3, then find the final amount of water in the final solution.

Solution: 
Let the initial amount of milk be 20x liters and the amount of water 7x liters.

Ratio of milk and water after adding 5 liters = 20x/(7x + 5) = 5/3
⇒ 60x = 35x + 25
⇒ 25x = 25
∴ x = 1

∴ Final amount of water in solution = 7x + 5 = 7 + 5 = 12 liters.

Question: The radius of a circle is same as the diagonal of a square whose area is 16 sq. cm. The area of the circle is -

Solution:
Area of square = 16
Side of square = √16 = 4

Diagonal of square = 4√2

So, the radius of the circle is 4√2 cm

Area of circle = πr2
= π(4√2)2

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪১) A boat takes 90 minutes less to travel 36 miles downstream than to travel the same distance upstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 10 mph, the speed of the stream is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: A boat takes 90 minutes less to travel 36 miles downstream than to travel the same distance upstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 10 mph, the speed of the stream is:

Solution:
Speed of the boat in still water = 10 mph
Let speed of the stream be x mph

Then, speed downstream = (10 + x) mph
speed upstream = (10 - x) mph

ATQ,
⇒ 36/(10 - x) - 36/(10 + x) = 90/60
⇒ 36/(10 - x) - 36/(10 + x) = 3/2
⇒ 12/(10 - x) - 12/(10 + x) = 1/2
⇒ 24(10 + x) - 24(10 - x) = (10 + x) (10 - x)
⇒ 240 + 24x - 240 + 24x = (100 - x2)
⇒ 48x = 100 - x2
⇒ x2 + 48x - 100 = 0
⇒ (x + 50) (x - 2) = 0
∴ x = 2

∴ The speed of the stream is 2 mph.

Question: The difference between a number and its square is 72. What is the number?

Solution:
Let, the number be x.

ATQ,
x2 - x = 72
⇒ x2 - x - 72= 0
⇒ x2 - 9x + 8x - 72 = 0
⇒ x(x - 9) + 8(x - 9) = 0
⇒ (x - 9) (x + 8) = 0
⇒ x - 9 = 0

Here,
x - 9 = 0
∴ x = 9

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪৯) Calculate the H.C.F of 2x<sup>2</sup> - 8 and x<sup>2</sup> + 4x + 4
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Question: Calculate the H.C.F of 2x2 - 8 and x2 + 4x + 4

Solution: 
2x2 - 8
= 2(x2 - 4)
= 2(x2 - 22)
= 2(x + 2)(x - 2)

And x2 + 4x + 4
= (x2 + 2 . x . 2 + 22)
= (x + 2)2
= (x + 2)(x + 2)

∴ Required H.C.F = x + 2
